statement: Every one of the 254 source-reported non-isomorphic nine-vertex tournaments in I_{3,3} \ I_{3,1} belongs to I_{5,1}: for each serialized representative, there exist five explicit strict total orders such that every tournament arc is supported by exactly three of the five orders.
contribution: A complete positive census resolving the frozen finite question. It supplies transparent adjacency data and five-order certificates for all 254 reported classes, with a separate exact recount of all 9,144 arcs; it does not claim either global inclusion in the margin hierarchy is an equality or strict.
